name: Tharisa plc
summary: Tharisa plc, an investment holding company, engages in the mining, processing, sale, and logistics of platinum group metals (PGMs) and chrome concentrates in South Africa, China, Singapore, Hong Kong, the United Arab Emirates, and internationally. It operates through four segments: PGM, Chrome, Agency and Trading, and Manufacturing. The company sells PGM concentrates, including platinum, palladium, rhodium, gold, ruthenium, iridium, nickel, and copper.
